d:
Bihar IPS officer Bhanu Pratap Singh has been removed as Khagaria SP amid a marital dispute with his wife, Pooja Singh. She has accused him and his family of harassment and alleged that she is being denied access to their six-year-old daughter. Here's the story of their relationship, his UPSC journey and the latest developments in the case.
